body:
tasha: Heads-up: late events affecting aggregates for 2026-03-20 22:10-22:40 UTC. Looks like a delayed publisher to the legacy bucket. Need a scoped replay and a quick console preflight.

mike: which shards/partitions? can we restrict it?

tasha: shards 2 and 3 only. rough rows ~48k.

anil: prefer preflight -> dry-run -> replay with dedupe. Console should show per-shard token estimates and an explicit "confirm quota bump" modal.

sue: UX: add a small CTA to show "expected impact on Dedicated burst" and require typing shard ids to confirm. ops want a one-click dry-run.

router-bot: preflight requested: `/api/replay/preflight` shards=2,3 window=2026-03-20T22:10Z..22:40Z

router-bot: preflight result: shard2=9.6k tokens, shard3=11.2k tokens, total=20.8k, est_duplicates=420, slot_seconds=180

tasha: that's under soft limits. will run dry-run now.

router-bot: dry-run complete. duplicates_found=413; token_estimate=20.7k; schema_check=ok

anil: schedule live replay in 10m. ensure router preserves X-Idempotency-Key on fallback (we had an issue last week).

mike: I'll own handoff and run `/replay run --shards 2,3 --dedupe --quota-override 22k` at start time. watching dashboards.

router-bot: live job started id=r-20260320-550 routing: burst->fallback-standard

mike: mid-run: shard2 had one transient S3 timeout, router retried and kept idempotency header. no duplicates observed.

router-bot: job finished. tokens_used=20,670 duplicates_removed=409. no SLO incidents.

tasha: follow-ups: (1) console preflight UI to include per-shard token breakout & override modal (sue), (2) quick router test to assert idempotency header passthrough (anil). I'll add a runbook entry for targeted replays.

sue: will mock the modal and post link shortly.

anil: I'll add a tiny e2e test for header passthrough.

tasha: thanks team, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
